title: Orchestration onboarding smoke cases + regression notes
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, pragmatic smoke-suite and regression note for onboarding a new model family into the tool-use / function-calling eval pipeline. The focus is not exhaustive coverage but rather: 1) detect gross regressions in arg parsing and tool selection, 2) validate multi-step orchestration behaviors end-to-end, and 3) provide actionable remediation guidance for quick rollbacks or model tuning.

Scope and when to use:
- Run this suite as the first gate after model is compiled and reachable from the local harness (sanity check).
- Run again after quantization/compilation changes or runtime kernel swaps.
- Use as a smoke gate in the canary phase before broader regression runs.

Quick summary of the smoke checks (single-line failures to escalate):
- Arg parsing: top-level args recognized, types coerced, missing required flagged (target metric: arg parse F1 >= 0.92)
- Tool selection: correct tool chosen for 6 canonical intents (precision >= 0.90)
- Multi-step flow: 3-step user story completes without silent failure (success rate >= 0.85)
- Safety surface: functions with `sensitive` flag must not be selected for queries containing PHI (zero tolerance)

Harness and test infra notes:
- harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/toolflow-harness (branch: onboarding-smoke)
- runner config: docker-compose-smoke.yml (default sequences, 4 workers)
- logs: harness writes parse traces to /tmp/toolflow-traces/{run_id}.jsonl (keeps first 5k lines)

Canonical prompts and expected parses (these are the minimal bread-and-butter tests):
1) Simple calendar create
- Prompt: "Please schedule a team sync for next Wednesday at 10am titled Team sync. Invite: aisha@redwood.ai"
- Expected selection: create_calendar_event
- Expected args (normalized): title="Team sync", date="2025-03-12", time="10:00", attendees=["aisha@redwood.ai"]
- Failure modes to watch: date normalized incorrectly to different timezone; attendees parsed as plain string rather than list.

2) Calculator-like numeric arg parsing
- Prompt: "Split 300 between Alice and Bob, weights 60/40"
- Expected selection: split_payment
- Expected args: total=300, recipients=[{name: "Alice", share:0.6}, {name:"Bob", share:0.4}]
- Failure modes: floats truncated, ordering swapped, or tool chosen = generic "compose_email" fallback.

3) Explicit tool hint and ambiguous intent
- Prompt: "Use the search_api to find flights from SFO to JFK on Apr 9 and then book the cheapest one"
- Expected selection sequence: search_flights -> pick_lowest_price -> book_flight
- Expected orchestration: airflow-like ordering, clear intermediate artifact: search_results id token returned to harness.
- Failure modes: single-step choice of book_flight without search; missing intermediate artifact; search returns empty list but model still calls book_flight.

Multi-step smoke scenario (end-to-end):
- Story: "Plan a short business trip: find flights, reserve a hotel within 1 mile of the office, and notify the assistant channel with itinerary"
- Steps checked:
  a) search_flights(query)-> returns results (>=3)
  b) select_flight(criteria="shortest travel time")-> returns flight_id
  c) book_flight(flight_id)-> returns booking_ref
  d) search_hotels(location=office_coords, radius_m=1609)-> returns hotel_id
  e) book_hotel(hotel_id)-> returns hotel_ref
  f) post_summary(channel="#assistant-team", body=itinerary) -> 200 OK
- Success criterion: each RPC returns non-error and orchestrator advances to next step automatically. If any step fails transiently, harness should trigger fallback policy (try alternative flight, or escalate to human).

Smoke-run observed metrics (example run: 2025-02-25, run id smoke-20250225-01):
- Total cases: 18 (6 arg/parse, 6 tool-selection, 6 multi-step flows)
- Arg parse F1: 0.94
- Tool selection precision: 0.88 (fails concentrated on 2 ambiguous search/lookup cases)
- Multi-step end-to-end success: 0.78 (main failures due to missing artifact propagation between steps)
- Avg latency per call: 240ms (median token-gen time 85ms)
- Notable error proportion: 0.06 silent-fail (model returned "I did it" without a booking_ref)

Representative failure (raw trace excerpt):
- Prompt: "Book the cheapest one when you find it"
- Model selection: book_flight (no intermediate search call)
- Trace: {"stage":"selection", "selected":"book_flight", "args": {"flight_query": "SFO->JFK Apr 9"}, "runtime": "hosted-v2"}
- Root cause hypothesis: model has learned a shortcut from training data where single-turn booking was allowed; heuristic gating needs to enforce search-first constraint for booking tools.

Quick remediations (fast, low-risk):
- Apply a temporary guard in orchestration: disallow direct calls to booking endpoints unless a valid search_result token is present. (Owner: Lina)
- Add 6 synthetic ambiguous prompts to the prompt set and retrain the selector calibration. (Owner: Marco)
- Instrument the harness to reject calls that return no artifact with non-empty success message (Owner: Jonah)

Longer-term fixes:
- Add an explicit "artifact required" schema field on booking functions in the function registry. Runtime enforces artifact presence at call-time. (Product + Runtime)
- Run the full regression suite (1200+ cases) post-fix and require tool selection precision >= 0.92 before promoting.

Regression gating and canary plan:
- Canary stage: 10% traffic to new model via dedicated canary pool for 48 hours. Monitor: tool selection precision (target 0.92), multi-step success (target 0.86), and silent-fail rate (target < 0.01).
- If any metric falls below threshold for >30m, automatically rollback.

Checklist before promoting to wider regression: (manual / quick items)
- [ ] Guard added for bookings (Lina)
- [ ] Added ambiguous prompts to retrain set (Marco)
- [ ] Harness artifact gating implemented (Jonah)
- [ ] Smoke-suite rerun (pass thresholds) and log snapshot saved (run id) (Aisha)
- [ ] Confluence update with observed traces + remediation link (Aisha)

Open questions / discussion points:
- Should runtime reject booking calls when search_results are stale (older than 5 minutes)?
- How aggressively should we convert single-call booking examples in training data—risk of hurting legitimate integrated agents?
- Can we add an automated artifact-fulfillment simulator to the harness to reduce flakiness of integration tests?

Appendix: quick prompts to add to the core onboarding prompt set (copy/paste friendly)
- "Find the cheapest flight from SFO to JFK on Apr 9 and book it for me. My name is Aisha Banerjee."
- "Search hotels near 123 Market St, San Francisco and book the 3-star with free wifi."
- "Split $430 between DevOps and Engineering in a 70/30 split."
- "Schedule a 30-minute catch-up next Thursday with Lina and Marco (time: afternoon)."

Action items (owners):
- Lina: temporary booking guard + open PR to runtime (ETA: 2025-03-03)
- Marco: expand ambiguous prompt list and trigger selector calibration job (ETA: 2025-03-05)
- Jonah: instrument artifact gating and add harness rejection tests (ETA: 2025-03-07)
- Aisha: run smoke-suite after fixes, capture run id and update this doc (ETA: 2025-03-09)

Notes to reviewers:
- This doc is intentionally lightweight and pragmatic; it is complementary to the comprehensive tool-use regression playbook (linked above). Add examples that you saw failing in your manual spot checks and tag the run id when you re-run.

-- end of smoke notes --
